1_bench.desc: The Bench is a basic seat for your Guests allowing them to take a rest.
24_padded_bench.desc: The Padded Bench is an improved seat for your Guests allowing them to regain their energy quicker.
25_massage_chair.desc: The ultimate in Guest seating, the Massage Chair is an attraction in its own right. The only downside is the complicated mechanisms inside can break down from time to time.
2_vending_machine_fizzy_drinks.desc: The Fizzy Drink Vending Machine allows your guests to quench their thirst while you pocket a little profit. Watch out for the litter!
20_coffee_vendor.desc: Help your Guests maintain their caffeine addiction while you enjoy the increased profit margins! One small caveat, they have been known to break down from time to time.
21_orange_vendor.desc: Freshly squeezed orange juice, a luxury no Guest can turn down. The vend time is a little longer, and the complicated squeezing mechanism is prone to breaking, but the huge margins make it all worth it!
3_vending_machine_chocolate.desc: Avoid hungry Guests by giving them something sweet to nibble on while they take in your exhibits.
22_popcorn_vendor.desc: While the internal popping engine is prone to breakdown, you'll forget all about it once you see how much you can charge for a handful of corn and some sugar.
23_froyo_vendor.desc: Guests can't resist the double-cool treat known as Frozen Yoghurt. Just don't tell them you're charging by the sprinkle!
4_toilet_cubicle.desc: This basic toilet will allow your Guests to void their bladders without embarrassing themselves or your fish! May require cleaning after concentrated use...
26_deluxe_toilet.desc: With velvet hand towels and silk toilet paper, the Deluxe Toilet allows your Guests to "powder their nose" in the most opulent of settings.
floor_arrow.desc: Send Guests in the right direction using these handy floor arrows.
oneway.desc: Prohibit Guests from entering certain areas from the wrong direction using these one-way gates.
bin.desc: Place bins in appropriate locations so Guests throw their litter in the bin rather than on the ground!
